description.la: Triginta sermones Thomae a Kempis, magistri novitiorum in monte S. Agnetis, de vita religiosa: de concordia fratrum, de obedientia, humilitate, oratione, tentationibus et aliis. Textus ex editione Pohl (1905).
description.en-US: Thirty conferences given by Thomas as master of novices at Mount St. Agnes, on the religious life: concord among brethren, obedience, humility, prayer, temptation and the rest. The Latin is Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1905), here from a raw OCR of the printed volume. Scully's 1907 English translation (Kegan Paul) is not yet imported.
description.pt-BR: Trinta conferências de Tomás, mestre de noviços no Monte Santa Inês, sobre a vida religiosa: concórdia entre os irmãos, obediência, humildade, oração, tentações e outros temas.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Sermones ad novicios, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1905), Opera omnia VI; archive.org raw OCR (Google scan).
sources.description: The thirty sermons in three parts, with Pohl's upper-case sermon titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical footnotes and introduction are not imported. The exempla and the Vita Lidewigis in the same volume are not part of this book. Raw OCR: drop capitals, margin glosses and isolated letters are sometimes garbled.

title.la: Pars prima
1. De concordia fratrum et melodia divinae laudis
2. De laude bonae congregationis
3. De verbis et consiliis seniorum humiliter audiendis
4. De bonis colloquiis invicem habendis
5. De patientia conservanda inter desides et perversos
6. De vigiliis nocturnis contra impugnationem soporis
7. Operis cum oboedientia superioris
8. De vana gloria cavenda et quod soli deo laus est exhibenda
9. De periculo multorum malorum ex multiloquio verborum
Pars secunda
1. De multis tribulationibus iustorum pro regno caelorum
2. De cotidiano martyrio et bello in statu religionis
3. De sapientia confessorum et continentia religiosorum
4. De cauta custodia cordis, et gratia internae devotionis
5. De constantia et perseverantia in statu religionis
6. De cauta custodia iuvenum contra multas temptationes
7. De districto dei iudicio ubi accusabunt nos omnes creaturae
8. De vana gloria vitanda, et humili oboedientia sectanda
9. De spirituali militia contra vitia
10. De variis bellis et periculis hvius vitae
Pars tertia
1. De cruce cotidie tollenda in religione assumpta
2. De veneratione et commemoratione beatae mariae virginis
3. Eius mariae
4. De devoto servitio beatae virginis et recordatione nominis eius
5. De dolore et consolatione beatae mariae virginis
6. De excellentia meritorum et privilegiis donorum beatae mariae virginis
7. De tribus speciosis vestibus beatissimae agnetis virginis
8. De aurea corona in capite sanctissimae agnetis virginis
9. In dedicatione ecclesiae. de quinque luminaribus templi
10. De ornamentis et moribus ministrorum in templo dei
11. De quatuor condicionibus ad aedificationem et decorem domus dei pertinentibus
